subject: Note-decay D: scalar confidence floor (DEG-RAG) — graded reliability for a tunable inject gate
description:
Borrow DEG-RAG's graded reliability. Forks off orch/feature/note-decay.

SCOPE: Augment the ~binary judge verdict with a SCALAR reliability/confidence score on the note (and/or its edges); persist it; let the inject gate threshold on it to tune precision/recall instead of all-or-nothing, and let retrieval ranking read it. Keep backward-compatible (absent score ⇒ current behavior). Tests. Commit onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.

summary: Implemented scalar confidence floor gate for RAG injection (DEG-RAG). Added computeConfidence(stats) using formula winRate*(total/(total+CONFIDENCE_PRIOR)), noteConfidenceMap(ws) convenience wrapper, and exported CONFIDENCE_PRIOR=4 and CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.3 (env-overridable via CONFIDENCE_FLOOR) in lib/recall-outcome-journal.js. Wired a filter block in routes/graph.js /search handler that drops note-kind RAG candidates whose recorded confidence < CONFIDENCE_FLOOR; notes absent from the journal pass at confidence=1.0 (new notes never penalised). 41 plain-Node tests in test/note-decay-confidence.test.js cover formula edge cases, map correctness, filter behaviour (below/at/above floor, no-history pass-through, non-note pass-through), and env var override. Existing note-decay.test.js: 30/30 still pass.
